name: Philomot
source:
Caught in a blizzard, Oscar stumbles upon a remote mansion. Its owners are polite, even kind, though undeniably odd.

Sleep comes quickly, but it brings no relief. Vivid nightmares plague him, and the mansion seems alive with secrets. Escaping the cold was only the beginning.

[From [url=https://sphinxious.itch.io/philomot]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
奥斯卡遭遇暴风雪，偶然发现了一栋偏僻的宅邸。它的主人很有礼貌，甚至很友善，但不可否认的是，它很奇怪。

睡眠来得很快，但并没有带来任何缓解。生动的噩梦困扰着他，这座宅邸似乎充满了秘密。逃离寒冷只是一个开始。

[来自[url=https://sphinxious.itch.io/philomot]Itch.io[/url]]
